svg.title: Resume–job fit analyzer architecture with Groq fallback
svg.desc: A frontend talks to a FastAPI backend that parses, structures, matches and scores, plus a chat handler. The backend calls Groq, trying a primary model and then two fallback models on error or rate limit, and keeps data in session memory.

g.text: Answers from resume, jobs and match table
Tried in order on error or 429
